tasks.title: Ensure Complete Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Review and enhance the calculator's mobile responsive design:

1. Read and review existing CSS files:
   - src/components/Calculator.css
   - src/components/Button.css
   - src/components/Display.css
   - src/App.css

2. Ensure proper responsive behavior:
   - Calculator layout adapts to small screens (320px - 480px)
   - Medium screens (481px - 768px)
   - Large screens (769px+)
   - Touch-friendly button sizes on mobile (min 44px)
   - Proper spacing and padding across all breakpoints
   - Font sizes scale appropriately
   - No horizontal scrolling on mobile

3. Fix any responsive issues found:
   - Add or update media queries as needed
   - Ensure flexbox/grid layouts work on all screen sizes
   - Verify viewport meta tag is present in index.html

4. Write comprehensive responsive tests:
   - Create or update tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
   - Test component rendering at different viewport widths
   - Verify button sizes are touch-friendly
   - Test layout doesn't break on small screens
   - Use @testing-library/react with window.matchMedia mocks if needed

5. Document responsive breakpoints in comments
acceptance_criteria: No horizontal scrolling occurs on any screen size
Responsive tests written and included in test files

tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Validate that the calculator is fully responsive on mobile devices:

1. Run the complete test suite:
   - Execute: npm test
   - Verify all tests pass, especially responsive tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx

2. Take screenshots at multiple device sizes:
   - Use the existing screenshot script or create a new one
   - Capture mobile (375px, 414px widths)
   - Capture tablet (768px width)
   - Capture desktop (1920px width)
   - Save to .eunomia/screenshots/qa/

3. Visually verify screenshots:
   - Calculator is centered and properly sized
   - All buttons are visible and properly spaced
   - Display is readable
   - No layout breaks or overflows
   - Touch targets are appropriately sized on mobile

4. Report any issues found
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots show proper layout on all device sizes
No visual breaks or layout issues detected
Touch targets meet minimum size requirements on mobile
